div.head: Ordal 1, 1a
div.ab: And of þam órdale we [be]beodað Godes bebodum ⁊ þæs arcebiscopes ⁊ ealra biscopa, þæt nán mann ne cúme innon þære ciricean, siððan man þæt fýr inbyrð, þe man þæt órdal mid hǽtan sceal, buton se mæssepreost ⁊ se ðe þartó gán sceal. [1a] ⁊ béo þǽr gemeten nygon fét of þam stácan to þære mearce be þæs mannes fótan, þe þártó gæð.

De ordalio precipimus in nomine Dei et precepto archiepiscopi et omnium episcoporum, ne aliquis intret in ecclesiam, postquam infertur ignis, unde iudicium calefieri debet, preter presbiterum et eum qui ad iudicium ire debet (iturus est). [1a] Et sint mensurati IX pedes a staca usque ad mercam, ad mensuram pedum eius, qui ad iudicium ire debet.

And of þam órdale we bebeodað Godes bebodum and þæs arcebiscopes and ealra bisceopa, þæt nán mann ne cúme innon þære ciricean, siððan man þæt fýr inbyrð, þe man þæt órdal mid hǽtan sceal, buton se mæssepreost and se þe þartó gán sceal; and béo þǽr gemeten nygon fét of þam stácan to þære mearce be þæs mannes fótan, þe þártó gæð.

Und betreffend das Ordal gebieten wir kraft der Gebote Gottes und des Erzbischofs [von Canterbury] und aller Bischöfe, dass niemand in die Kirche hinein komme, sobald das Feuer hineingetragen wird, womit das Ordal[eisen oder -wasser] erhitzt werden soll, ausgenommen der Priester und wer dort zu[m Ordal] schreiten soll. [1a] 1a. Und es werde da 9 Fuss, gemäss des Mannes Füssen, der dort zu[m Ordal] schreiten wird, ausgemessen von den Pfählen (dem Pfahle?) bis zum Ziele.

1. And concerning the ordeal we command, by the commands of God and of the archbishop [of Canterbury] and of all the bishops, that no one come into the church once the fire is carried in with which the ordeal [iron or water] is to be heated, except the priest and whoever is to go to [the ordeal] there. 1a. And let 9 feet be measured there, by the feet of the man who will go to [the ordeal], from the stakes (the stake?) to the mark.

And with regard to the ordeal, by the commands of God and of the archbishop and all the bishops, we enjoin that no one shall enter the church after the fire with which the iron or water for the ordeal is to be heated has been brought in, except the mass-priest and him who has to go to trial. And from the stake to the mark, nine feet shall be measured by the feet of him who goes to the trial.

nicht ‘angebrannt’ (Schmid, verwechselnd mit byrneð).—Noch fehlt bischöfliche Aufsicht; s. Gl Ordal 13; Feuerordal 2; Eisenordal 6b. 9. c.—Noch 1319 sagt zu Edward II. sein des Verrates bezichtigter Vetter Graf Thomas von Lancaster: in ferro candenti offero me purgaturum; Mon. Malmesber. ed. Stubbs Chron. of Edw. II 249

Not ‘burnt’ (Schmid, confusing it with byrneð).—There is as yet no episcopal supervision; see Gl Ordal 13; Feuerordal 2; Eisenordal 6b. 9. c.—As late as 1319 Earl Thomas of Lancaster, Edward II's cousin, accused of treason, says to him: in ferro candenti offero me purgaturum; Mon. Malmesber. ed. Stubbs Chron. of Edw. II 249
Den regulären Sing. nehmen an Q, auch 5, 1 und Toller s. v. Beim späten Zeitalter H's könnte auch Plural gemeint sein. Dies nimmt Q 4, 2 an
Q assumes the regular sing., as also at 5, 1, and so does Toller s. v. Given H's late date, the plural could also be meant. Q assumes this at 4, 2
Nach des Prüflings Fuss misst auch Indisches Eisenordal; Kaegi in Festschr. 39. Versa. Dt. Philolo. Zürich 48. Auch Ags. Zaubersegen ähneln Altindischen; Schröer Grundz. Engl. Lit. G. I 34²

The Indian iron ordeal also measures by the foot of the person undergoing it; Kaegi in Festschr. 39. Versa. Dt. Philolo. Zürich 48. Anglo-Saxon charms also resemble Old Indian ones; Schröer Grundz. Engl. Lit. G. I 34²
cf. § 4. The iron had to be carried from the stake (post) to the mark which defined the distance.
